name: color-swatch
summary: A colour picker where the chosen swatch settles in as a ring springs out around it.
props: One horizontally scrolling row instead of a wrapping grid.
Style for the wrapping grid (the ScrollView when scrollable).
behavior: Tap a swatch to choose it. Each swatch's hit area is padded out to 44pt.
The chosen swatch settles inward while a ring and check spring out. The check uses whichever ink reads best on that colour.
A radiogroup labelled "Colour" by default; each swatch is a radio named by its label or hex value.
